```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(jsonlite)

source("/workspaces/reports/lib/ggplot/switchbox_theme.R")

```

```{r}
path_metadata_u0 <- "/workspaces/reports/data/resstock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/MA_baseline_metadata_and_annual_results.csv"

columns_to_keep <- c(
  "bldg_id",
  "in.sqft",
  "in.city",
  "in.county",
  "in.heating_fuel",
  "in.hvac_has_ducts",
  "in.hvac_cooling_type",
  "in.hvac_cooling_efficiency",
  "in.hvac_heating_efficiency",
  "in.hvac_heating_type",
  "in.hvac_heating_type_and_fuel",
  "in.hvac_secondary_heating_efficiency",
  "in.hvac_secondary_heating_type_and_fuel",
  "in.income",
  "in.vintage"
)

meta_u0 <- read_csv(
  path_metadata_u0,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select = all_of(columns_to_keep)
)

```


```{r}

# Filter for heat pump systems (those with HSPF efficiency ratings)
meta_u0_hp <- meta_u0 |>
  filter(str_detect(in.hvac_heating_efficiency, "HSPF"))
# Extract HSPF values from efficiency string
meta_u0_hp <- meta_u0_hp |>
  mutate(
    hspf = as.numeric(str_extract(in.hvac_heating_efficiency, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=\\s*HSPF)"))
  )

View(meta_u0_hp)

# Create bar chart of HSPF values
ggplot(meta_u0_hp, aes(x = factor(hspf))) +
  geom_bar(fill = sb_colors["midnight"], width = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Heat Pump HSPF Values",
    x = "HSPF Rating",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))



```
